section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Solving Rational Equations and Radical Equations

title: Solve d + sqrt(x + a) = x (one extraneous root)
sources: OpenStax College Algebra 2e §2.6 p. 149 (CC BY 4.0): method only

steps.name: raise both sides to the same power
check every answer in the original equation
steps.show: x = {h} gives a principal square root equal to {h} - {d} < 0: false

mistakes.name: kept the extraneous root
mistakes.message: Squaring brought in an extra root: check each answer in the original equation.

hints.hint: Move everything else to the other side.
hints.why: Squaring a sum with a radical in it leaves a radical.

hints.step: raise both sides to the same power
hints.hint: Square both sides; (x - d)^2 needs its middle term.
hints.why: Principle of powers: if a = b then a^2 = b^2.

hints.step: check every answer in the original equation
hints.hint: Put each answer back into the first equation.
hints.why: Squaring can create a solution that doesn't work.
